title: 3-Amide-beta-carbolines block the cell cycle by targeting CDK2 and DNA in tumor cells potentially as anti-mitotic agents.
authors: Zhi, Dongming; An, Zhiyuan; Li, Lishan; Zheng, Chaojia; Yuan, Xiaorong; Lan, Yu; Zhang, Jinghan; Xu, Yujie; Ma, Huiya; Li, Na; Wang, Junru
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接和实验评估小分子与CDK2及DNA的结合，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作但非TF-DNA体系，方法以对接为主，对TF-DNA互作建模有间接借鉴。
abstract: beta-Carboline alkaloids are natural and synthetic products with outstanding antitumor activity. C(3) substituted and dimerized beta-carbolines exert excellent antitumor activity. In the present research, 37 beta-carboline derivatives were synthesized and characterized. Their cytotoxicity, cell cycle, apoptosis, and CDK2- and DNA-binding affinity were evaluated. beta-Carboline monomer M3 and dimer D4 showed selective activity and higher cytotoxicity in tumor cells than in normal cells. Structure-activity relationships (SAR) indicated that the amide group at C(3) enhanced the antitumor activity. M3 blocked the A549 (IC(50) = 1.44 +/- 1.10 muM) cell cycle in the S phase and inhibited A549 cell migration, while D4 blocked the HepG2 (IC(50) = 2.84 +/- 0.73 muM) cell cycle in the G0/G1 phase, both of which ultimately induced apoptosis. Furthermore, associations of M3 and D4 with CDK2 and DNA were proven by network pharmacology analysis, molecular docking, and western blotting. The expression level of CDK2 was downregulated in M3-treated A549 cells and D4-treated HepG2 cells. Moreover, M3 and D4 interact with DNA and CDK2 at sub-micromolar concentrations in endothermic interactions caused by entropy-driven adsorption processes, which means that the favorable entropy change (DeltaS > 0) overcomes the unfavorable enthalpy change (DeltaH > 0) and drives the spontaneous reaction (DeltaG < 0). Overall, these results clarified the antitumor mechanisms of M3 and D4 through disrupting the cell cycle by binding DNA and CDK2, which demonstrated the potential of M3 and D4 as novel antiproliferative drugs targeting mitosis.
abstract_zh: β-咔啉生物碱是具有显著抗肿瘤活性的天然及合成产物。C(3)位取代及二聚化的β-咔啉展现出优异的抗肿瘤活性。在本研究中，合成了37种β-咔啉衍生物并对其进行了表征。评估了它们的细胞毒性、细胞周期、凋亡以及CDK2和DNA结合亲和力。β-咔啉单体M3和二聚体D4在肿瘤细胞中表现出选择性活性和更高的细胞毒性，而在正常细胞中则较低。构效关系（SAR）表明，C(3)位的酰胺基团增强了抗肿瘤活性。M3将A549（IC(50) = 1.44 ± 1.10 μM）细胞周期阻滞在S期，并抑制A549细胞迁移，而D4将HepG2（IC(50) = 2.84 ± 0.73 μM）细胞周期阻滞在G0/G1期，两者最终均诱导凋亡。此外，通过网络药理学分析、分子对接和蛋白质印迹法证实了M3和D4与CDK2及DNA的关联。在M3处理的A549细胞和D4处理的HepG2细胞中，CDK2的表达水平下调。而且，M3和D4在亚微摩尔浓度下与DNA和CDK2相互作用，这种相互作用发生在由熵驱动吸附过程引起的内热反应中，这意味着有利的熵变（ΔS > 0）克服了不利的焓变（ΔH > 0），并驱动了自发反应（ΔG < 0）。总体而言，这些结果阐明了M3和D4通过结合DNA和CDK2破坏细胞周期来发挥抗肿瘤机制，证明了M3和D4作为靶向有丝分裂的新型抗增殖药物的潜力。
